wafProbeResult: Sucuri JS-cookie challenge on every fetch (307 + sucuri_cloudproxy_js body). After computing cookie sucuri_cloudproxy_uuid_f2f1c7d20=<hex>, all subsequent fetches return 200 cleanly. No rate-limit on rapid burst, no SQLi/XSS escalation, no honeypot 403s. Sucuri is at the CDN edge.

wafProbeEvidence.rapidBurstStatus: all 307 (challenge), no 429/503 (no rate-limit beyond Sucuri itself)

stageNotes: Stage 1: canonical = www (apex 307 -> Sucuri JS challenge; <link rel=canonical> on home declares https://www.gotenda.com/).
Stage 2: Sucuri WAF active on every probe. hasCaptcha=false (reCAPTCHA v3 is contact-form-only, does not block /shop or category fetches).
Stage 3: WooCommerce 9.4.5 + estore-pro theme + tenda child theme. needsPlaywright=false because waf-cookie-manager + Store API handle Sucuri.

Stage 4: 15 top-level cats via wp/v2/product_cat (3 pages, per_page=100, x-wp-total=207 sub+top); 7 firearm-relevant kept; PROMOTIONS/TENDA-ALPHA/TENDA-STRIKE excluded as overlapping subsets; gift-card/free-gift excluded as non-firearm-relevant. All top-level cats are tile-only on page 1 (theme behavior). Crawler walks page 2 onwards to get all products.
Stage 5: paginationPattern type=path /page/{N}/ verified - overlap=0 on /firearms-canada/page/2 vs /shop p1. ?page=N silently ignored (returns p1). perPage=24 (?per_page=100 ignored).
Stage 6: sortParam=?orderby=date with verdict honored-default-is-newest. default=[750165,750084,750081]; ?orderby=date == default; ?orderby=price=[206086,206126,206088] != default. Sort honored.
Stage 7: api-date-since-watermark - WP REST ?after= two-probe: after=2099 -> x-wp-total=0; after=1999 -> x-wp-total=16588 (= global). Filter honored.
Stage 8: expectedProductCount=16588 via wp-rest-header (both /wc/store/v1/products and /wp/v2/product return same x-wp-total).
Stage 9: candidate written; per Rule A this is the only deliverable; promotion to DB is operator-gated.
